blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — On Wednesday, the national government began releasing the monthly allowances of Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) members serving in the Joint Peace and Security Teams (JPSTs), a security mechanism under the Bangsamoro peace agreement. The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (OPAPRU) said 362 MILF members are deployed across 24 JPST stations in Mindanao, each receiving a monthly allowance of about P17,850, depending on the number of days served in a month. In a statement, OPAPRU said the remaining 2026 allowances are due in November and December after the government’s mandated liquidation and accounting […]...
